|os = {{Name|Frozen Geode|3.33%}}{{Name|Omni Geode|1%}}{{Name|Artifact Trove|3.6%}} |dr = {{Name|Drum Block}} |sellprice = 100 }} The '''Ancient Drum''' is an [[Artifacts|Artifact]] that can be found by digging up an [[Artifact Spot]] in [[Cindersap Forest]], [[Pelican Town]], or the [[Bus Stop]] area. It can also be found inside [[Frozen Geode]]s, [[Omni Geode]]s, and [[Artifact Trove]]s. ==Donation== Donation of this item contributes to the total count of donations for the [[Museum]]. After donating at least 2 other [[artifacts]], donation of the Ancient Drum rewards the player with a [[Drum Block]]. ==Gifting== {{GiftsByItem |like=Dwarf,Penny |dislike=Robin,Demetrius,Maru,Sebastian,Linus,Pierre,Caroline,Abigail,Alex,George,Evelyn,Lewis,Clint,Pam,Emily,Haley,Jas,Vincent,Jodi,Kent,Sam,Leah,Shane,Marnie,Elliott,Gus,Wizard,Harvey,Sandy,Willy,Krobus,Leo }} ==Tailoring== The Ancient Drum is used in the spool of the [[2 Willow Lane#Sewing Machine|Sewing Machine]] to create the [[Tailoring|Regal Mantle]]. [[File:Shirt243.png|24px]] It can be used in [[dyeing]], serving as a purple dye at the dye pots, located in [[Emily]]'s and [[Haley]]'s house, [[2 Willow Lane]]. ==Quests== The Ancient Drum is not used in any [[quests]]. ==History== {{History|1.0|Introduced.}} {{History|1.4|Added [[Artifact Trove]] as a source.
